supplementaryDisplacementQuantiles.role: descriptive stability check only; no displacement is filtered

definitions.N: count of exact-nonzero realized post-collision segments
definitions.neighborMismatch: undirected horizontal and vertical interior-cell pairs; angular mismatch is acos(clamp(Re(z1*conj(z2))/(|z1||z2|),-1,1)); Q director mismatch is half the complex phase difference; supported cells require N>=support and |z|>1e-12; no segmentation or defect threshold
definitions.winding: grid loop TL,TR,BR,BL; +x right, +y down; branch interval [-pi,pi)

plateRelation.referenceType: same-time horizontal reflection; deterministic descriptive reference, not a statistical null
plateRelation.reflection: x -> 1-x; preserves row coverage, all four boundary-distance marginals and x=0.5 entrance axis
